objective: Preallocate BM25 result vectors from the known score map size before sorting and limiting.

tasks.title: Preallocate BM25 result buffer
tasks.result: BM25 search now preallocates the result vector from scores.len() before moving score entries into the sortable result buffer.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was full.
A combined cargo test command with two filters was rejected by Cargo before running tests; the two hybrid-search filters were then run separately and passed.
The change preserves BM25 scoring, HashMap iteration semantics, select_nth_unstable_by limiting, and final score sort order.
